context._comment_user: There is deliberately NO default `user` here. Every learner must pass -c user=<theirname>, and app.py exits with an explanation if they do not. A default would let two people deploy identical resource names into one account and collide mid-deploy.
context._comment_raw_bucket: `raw_bucket` is derived in app.py as nbs-<user>-raw-<account>. Set it here only to force a specific bucket name.
